description.value: Real Things Pizza is a community-rooted, takeout-only pizza joint in Naramata staffed by local teenagers, known for handmade crusts and inventive combinations well beyond standard offerings. Delivery is available — including right to the beach — making it a relaxed option for cyclists on the Naramata Bench who don't want to interrupt their ride for a sit-down meal. Gluten-free crust and vegan/vegetarian options extend its appeal to riders with dietary needs.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a takeout-only pizza operation at 961 Robinson Avenue, Naramata, with phone (250) 496-4008 and online/phone ordering plus beach delivery. OSM diet tags (vegan=yes, vegetarian=yes, gluten_free=yes) are corroborated by the website's Kids menu noting 'GF not available in Kids Meal size,' confirming GF crust exists for standard orders. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms on-site, or water refill appears in either the website content or OSM tags; as a takeout-only business, on-site washrooms are unlikely but unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM tags include cryptocurrency payment methods (currency:XBT, payment:lightning, payment:onchain, payment:coinos) — unusual but not a directory concern.
OSM hours (16:30-20:30) differ slightly from website hours (4:30-8:30 pm / closed Mondays) — the website is more specific and should be treated as authoritative.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active takeout-only pizza spot in a popular cycling area (Naramata Bench) with dietary options and beach delivery — a practical and cyclist-friendly food stop worth listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website Kids menu notes 'GF not available in Kids Meal size,' confirming GF crust is available for regular orders
